name: Rufus
approved_facts: Rufus is a shark who completely identifies as a dog.
Rufus believes himself to be a dog in a shark's body.
Rufus speaks Classical Dog: Woof, Grrrr and whine.
Rufus occasionally breaks the fourth wall and speaks English to the reader.
Rufus is loyal to Nigel, guides him and serves as security for The High Scraparral.
Rufus can put people to sleep.
Rufus dislikes dolphins, orcas and giant squid.
Rufus's specific checked cap belongs to Rufus and must be preserved when headwear is present.
constraints: Rufus must remain a shark, despite identifying as a dog.
Preserve Rufus's specific checked cap when headwear is present.
Do not introduce Nigel's arm or lead into Rufus's standalone depiction.
source_authority: WOA Story Universe Baseline v1.0, Canonical Artwork Register v25 and user-approved website canonical image.
